description:
The sites linking to any domain (the workspace's own or a competitor's), strongest first: each referring domain's rank (0–1000), live backlinks, dofollow, first seen and spam score, plus the top anchors and totals. Data: DataForSEO's backlink index.

Billing: 20¢ per call. Not billed when nothing comes back or the call fails; the same call within 24h is free. No-account server: one free data call a day without credit.

When to call: which sites link to a domain (link-building targets, a competitor's links). Counts only (rank, totals, spam score): get_backlink_summary, free.

Returns { target, total_referring_domains, total_anchors, referring_domains: [{domain, rank, backlinks, dofollow, first_seen, new?, spam_score, likely_spam?}], dofollow_share, new_last_30_days, likely_spam, top_anchors, suggested_next?, cached, charged_cents }. Live links only. likely_spam: spam score 30+ (paid or PBN links are a risk, not a win). suggested_next compares with the site's first competitor, or the competitor with the site.

site_id.description: A workspace site (list_sites): the target when domain is omitted, and "your site" for the comparison step when both are given.

name: get_referring_domains
